area: Thames at Bugsby's Reach / Blackwall: Thames Iron Works dry docks (west), the Royal Albert & Victoria Docks Cut and railway sidings, Victoria Dock Pier and Dolphin, river-wall frontage to the entrance of the Royal Victoria Dock; most of the mosaic is river water
method: sheet + 9 sweep crops at 2x (anchors: r0c0 Thames boundary with + marks, Cn; r0c1 DRY DOCK, Mooring Posts, Crane; r0c2 Royal Albert & Victoria Docks Cut; r1c0 river with boundary and 'B'; r1c1 Crane, Mud; r1c2 Victoria Dock Pier, Dolphin, F.S.; r2c0 B u g s b y ' s lettering; r2c1 open river, end of Bugsby's; r2c2 Mooring / B.M.17·27 / foreshore stones). Contact sheets g1, g5 (5x), g6, g7 (12x), nn3 (20x/10x nearest), region views g2, g3 (4x), g4 (10x), marker sheets mk8 (6x), mk9 (8x). Every crop and sheet displayed when opened; anchors in notes.
legibility: Clean print. Horizontal sheet join py ~586-590 across the full width (tint step, river only, no figures cut). No missing tiles. River water and the sidings carry no figures.
